notes: Label = microcontroller port name (P###) where a Micro column is printed, otherwise the signal name next to the pin. Group bracket tags (SCI9, USB_HS, ANALOG...), IN/OUT power icons and D (default) icons omitted. Image 1 has a transparent background (dark text invisible on dark render); pin numbers become visible when flattened on white. Image 1 and 3 print J1 pin 45 as "I2C1 SD6"; images 5 and 6 print "I2C1 SCL". Image 10 shows only labeled test points (no connector rows) and is not transcribed; USB-C signals on image 4 are not transcribed (no physical pin positions). Battery connector skipped.
